items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: Ish hired me... that’s how I happened to be with the Isham Jones band until October

ctx.x: No. I can’t think. But anyway, he impressed me. I had got wind of —

When I left New Orleans I was headed for New York. But I stopped in Philadelphia because a fine trumpet player from New Orleans, Danny Ryan, was in Philadelphia. So I go up to the rooming house and a lady opened the door and she says, “Oh, Danny is playing in Ocean City” with a certain band. I went there and Danny said that Adrian Fleiss was a violin player from New Orleans, was playing with the George Olson band in Atlantic City at the Ritz Carlton. I go there but Olson had just left. And this is a true story. I…

come here tomorrow, Ish is rehearsing” and so forth. I went there the next day with my alto, clarinet and I had baritone with me, and Ish hired me but the guys didn’t like me. You know why? They all wanted a raise. They wanted a raise.
